subject: SOC 2 Type II exceptions — remediation sprint & evidence plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: compliance@finrise.com, auditor@big4audit.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II exceptions — remediation sprint & evidence plan

Hi Sara / FinRise compliance team,

Thanks again for the call last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to lay out a short remediation "sprint" plan for the two open exceptions called out in your draft report (control IDs C-3 and N-7) and confirm the types of evidence you will accept for interim closure while we complete permanent controls.

High-level plan (2-week sprint):
- Week 1 (May 31 — Jun 6): configuration hardening + documented change (owner: Marcus) — deliver network-change-log.pdf + change ticket ids
- Week 2 (Jun 7 — Jun 13): evidence collection and test artifacts (owner: Neha) — deliver screenshots, test run outputs, and updated remediation_tracker.xlsx

Requested acceptance items from FinRise:
- A bridge-style confirmation that interim evidence described above is acceptable for the audit period ending 2027-06-30 (we can provide an interim bridge letter if needed)
- Confirmation whether exported firewall change logs + signed change-tickets are sufficient for C-3
- For N-7 (user access recertification workflow), whether screenshots + audit CSVs from our IAM system are acceptable prior to formal process automation

Attachments: remediation_tracker.xlsx (initial task list), network-change-log.pdf (sample from last quarter).

Next steps: if you confirm by EOD tomorrow we will kick off the sprint and aim to deliver initial artifacts by the morning of Jun 7. If FinRise prefers a formal bridge letter template, we can draft one and route for signature.

Thanks —
Logan
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Gomez <sara@finrise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: auditor@big4audit.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II exceptions — remediation sprint & evidence plan

Logan —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from FinRise compliance: 

1) Bridge letter: yes, we accept an interim bridge letter that clearly states what was in place during the audit period and what was remediated after the period. Please include the timeframe for any post-period changes.

2) For C-3: exported firewall change logs + signed change tickets are acceptable, but we need:
   - a CSV export with timestamps and user IDs, and
   - the corresponding change-ticket links (or PDF copies).

3) For N-7: screenshots + CSV exports of IAM recertification results are acceptable, but please include a short narrative describing manual steps taken and owners who approved the changes.

We will route this to our auditor for confirmation on the bridge letter wording. Auditor please advise if the above meets audit requirements or if you need additional detail.

Thanks,
Sara Gomez
Head of Security & Compliance
FinRise

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II exceptions — remediation sprint & evidence plan

Thanks Sara — noted. Marcus and I split the tasks and I updated remediation_tracker.xlsx with owners and deliverable filenames. Quick status: 

- Marcus: completing firewall configuration changes tomorrow, will export CSV and attach PDFs of change tickets (JIRA-SUP-7843).
- I will run the IAM recert now and pull the CSV, and take the screenshots of approval pages.

Planned deliverables (for Jun 7):
- network-change-log.pdf (CSV + summary)
- ctl-test-screenshots.zip (screenshots from IAM console)
- remediation_tracker.xlsx (updated with evidence links)

Marcus — ping me once you post the change tickets so I can link them in the tracker.

-Neha
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Auditor Team <auditor@big4audit.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Sara Gomez <sara@finrise.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II exceptions — remediation sprint & evidence plan

Logan / Sara / team —

Thanks for the plan. A couple of notes from the audit side: 
- The CSV export should include immutable timestamps and the system account that made the change (not just the human approver). If your change system separates the two, include both files.
- For the IAM screenshots, we need at least one screen showing the full recertification run summary and one showing an individual user approval with timestamp.
- Please include the bridge letter draft (PDF) when you submit artifacts; we will need to review wording prior to final acceptance.

If you can deliver the items by morning Jun 7 UTC, we will aim to review and provide a preliminary acceptance note by Jun 10.

Regards,
Alex Ribeiro
Manager, IT Audit
Big4 Audit LLP

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@finrise.com>, auditor@big4audit.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II exceptions — remediation sprint & evidence plan

All —

Short update and deliverables (per commitments):

Delivered this morning (files attached):
- remediation_tracker.xlsx (rows marked COMPLETE for C-3 and N-7)
- network-change-log.pdf (CSV export + change-ticket PDFs linked in the tracker)
- ctl-test-screenshots.zip (IAM recertification summary + sample user approval)
- draft_bridge_letter.pdf (attached)

Responses to auditor notes:
- CSV exports include system-level and human approver fields (see network-change-log.pdf, column headers).
- IAM screenshots include both the recert run summary and an individual approval with timestamp.

Next steps: auditor review requested by Jun 10; FinRise team — if the bridge letter draft needs edits I will update and re-route for signature. We will keep these artifacts available in the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRemediationTracker

Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.

— Logan
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
